title: ArchaeoPhD Phase 2 Step 4 Sealed Evaluation Benchmark
benchmark_provenance: Sealed against development tuning; authored by the engineering team prior to candidate generator code; consists of 60 synthetic and styled archaeological test passages (30 finding positives, 30 hard adversarial negatives) containing extraction, unit binding, clausal span delimitation, and non-finding rejection challenges. Not drawn from raw uninspected scans.

benchmark_policy.clearance_scope: Permits candidate presentation in human verification queue only. Does NOT grant auto-commit authority.
benchmark_policy.auto_accept_requirement: Autonomous fact ingestion remains locked (is_human_verified gate). Enabling auto-commit requires a subsequent statistically powered validation trial of N >= 180 consecutive error-free facts (W <= 2.0% upper bound) and N >= 100 non-findings with zero false inclusions (Wilson lower bound >= 96.3%).

positive_attribution_precision.scoring_rubric: Scored strictly under the 5 outcome categories (CORRECT=pass; UNIT_LOST, PARTIAL, DISPLACED, ABSENT = failure).

unit_preservation.scope: All positive facts possessing a physical measurement unit (m, cm, mm, km, ft, in, kg, g, %) or chronological era marker (BCE, BC, CE, AD, BP). Bare counts (e.g. 694 tools) are integer counts attributed to artifact entity classes, not physical units.
